title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity + v1.81.0 version bump
author: Alex Morgan
description:
Summary: This PR unifies authentication, retries, and streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs; fixes behavioral parity gaps; and bumps package versions to v1.81.0. Motivation: we've diverged across SDKs on how auth tokens are provided, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics which causes frequent customer confusion and duplicated integration work. This change aims to provide a consistent developer experience across languages and to prepare for the v1.81 release.

Details (single-line continuous string): - Introduced a common auth interface pattern: SDKs now accept either a credentials object or an async/sync token provider; deprecated older ENV-only flows (kept backward-compatible shims). - Standardized retry semantics: default max attempts (3), jittered exponential backoff, idempotency-aware retries for non-streaming RPCs, and consistent 429/503 handling across SDKs. - Streaming ergonomics: unified streaming shape so consumers can use async iterators (Python/TS) and channel-based streaming in Go; added abort/cancel helpers and improved reconnection logic for transient network errors. - Parity fixes: fixed edge cases in Python where stream chunk boundaries could drop tokens; aligned TypeScript error types with Go/Python; made Go client return identical error codes and retry metadata headers. - Version bumps: updated SDK package versions to v1.81.0 and updated changelogs/compat notes. - Tests: added cross-SDK e2e tests that validate auth provider swapping, retry behavior under synthetic 429 bursts, and streaming resume after transient disconnects. - Docs: updated quickstarts and migration notes; added new FAQ entries for auth/retry migration.

Checklist: [x] unit tests updated/added [x] integration e2e tests added [x] docs updated [x] changelog and upgrade guide updated [x] release version bumps applied

Related: Linear ENG-9123 (SDK parity project), ENG-9130 (streaming ergonomics), referenced in PRs for SDK package publishing.

release_notes: SDKs: unify auth provider interfaces, standardize retry behavior (3 attempts, exponential backoff, idempotency-aware), improve streaming ergonomics (async iterators, abort helpers), fix parity issues across Python/TS/Go. Bumped SDK versions to v1.81.0. See docs/sdk/migration-auth-retries.md for migration steps.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps backward-compatible shims for existing env-var-based auth to avoid immediate breaking changes. We will deprecate legacy usage in the next minor release after customer outreach.
ci_flaky_notes: One flaky test (ts/stream/reconnect) was stabilized by adding a 50ms backoff in the test harness; noted in test metadata.
